content_zh: 本页包含重要的安全信息和保修注意事项。
content_en: This page contains important safety information and notes for warranty.

content_zh: 整个摆动路径。定期检查您的立柱，根据需要调整支架或拧紧硬件。在进行任何维护之前，请关闭开门器的电源。
content_en: its entire swing path. Periodically check your posts, adjusting brackets or tightening hardware as needed. Turn off the power to the gate opener before performing any maintenance.

content_zh: 障碍物保护测试：每月测试开门器。当门与刚性物体接触或当物体激活非接触式传感器时，门必须反向或停止。调整力量或限位行程后，重新测试开门器。未能正确调整和重新测试开门器可能会增加受伤或死亡的风险。
content_en: OBSTRUCTION PROTECTION TESTING: Test the gate opener monthly. The gate must reverse or stop on contact with a rigid object or when an object activates the non-contact sensors. After adjusting the force or limit travel, retest the gate opener. Failure to adjust and retest the gate opener properly can increase the risk of injury or death.
embedding_text: Important Safety Information: OBSTRUCTION PROTECTION TESTING, 障碍物保护测试

content_zh: 电源断开和手动开启：了解如何断开电源并手动打开门。只有当门不移动且开门器系统关闭时，才能将开门器与门断开。
content_en: POWER DISCONNECTION AND MANUAL OPENING: Understand how to disconnect the power and manually open the gate. Disconnect the gate opener from the gate only when the gate is not in motion and the gate opener system is turned off.
embedding_text: Important Safety Information: POWER DISCONNECTION AND MANUAL OPENING, 电源断开, 手动开启

content_zh: 识别自动化门系统中的潜在风险：妥善保管安装手册。确保所有使用或靠近门和开门器的人都了解自动化门系统的危险。如果需要更换手册，可以从TOPENS网站（www.topens.com）下载副本。
content_en: RECOGNIZE POTENTIAL RISKS IN AUTOMATED GATE SYSTEMS: Save the installation manual. Make sure everyone who is using or will be around the gate and gate opener are aware of the dangers of automated gate systems. If a replacement manual is needed, you can download a copy from the TOPENS website (www.topens.com)
embedding_text: Important Safety Information: RECOGNIZE POTENTIAL RISKS IN AUTOMATED GATE SYSTEMS, 潜在风险, 自动化门系统

content_en: WARRANTY LIMITED TO TARGET MARKET: The warranty is limited to the target market (Contiguous United States, Canada, UK, and Germany). Customers using the product outside these regions will be responsible for any additional expenses during the warranty replacement process.

content_en: GATE OPENER ABUSE: TOPENS does not cover damage resulting from abuse, such as attempting to operate the gate opener beyond its specified capacity or using it for unintended purposes.

content_zh: 第三方配件：TOPENS 不承担由第三方配件造成的损坏，除非是 TOPENS 客户支持明确推荐的配件。使用兼容配件以确保兼容性并防止开门器损坏非常重要。
content_en: THIRD PARTY ACCESSORIES: TOPENS does not cover damage caused by third party accessories, except those specifically recommended by TOPENS Customer Support. It is important to use only compatible accessories to ensure compatibility and prevent damage to the gate opener.
